reviews.text: Such a wonderful atmosphere such a wonderful staff treated with respect and Dr Paula such a wonderful experience

We were seen right on time and it was very fast to get two vaccines and a microchip. The office staff was friendly and helpful. The vet was kind and competent, especially since my cat was nervous hearing dogs in another room. The price seemed reasonable and it is a good location for me, close to where I live in Parkchester .
They are excellent and the service is very good, and the doctors are wonderful, as are the nurses and receptionists. Wow, I'm delighted!
I visited them several months ago when my pet was sick and they were extremely kind and helped me when I was in a desperate situation with my 4 month old kitten.
Call and call and can't get a live person on the phone. Not even for an appointment to discuss what's ailing my cat. Going to a more reliable vet.
Parking is fair .  Service is good

Back in March my female cat Sister had emergency surgery for spayed it was a very pleasant experience my cat instantly relaxed once the Dr examined her. Everyone was so nice even a cat came out to greet us not sure if it was the clinic cat or a patient after I signed and made the payment I was advice to come pick her up at 4 that went smoothly they gave me her discharge papers medication and food l left with a smile on my face and just happy that my cat was fine. Her sister is also getting spayed this week Thank you guys for making my visit a pleasant one see you !! Sister is on the left she was spayed in March fluffy is on the right she has her appointment this week 🫶🏾

I had the worst experience at this clinic!! In the beginning everything was wonderful but when the payment and services were done, that's when my nightmare started!! On July 3 2026 I took my dog oreo to have a mass removal and dental clinic, the total was $2500!! I dropped him off at 9am i waited till 2pm for them to call me to come pick him up!! Instead I showed up amd I was told that is was taking longer for him to recover from the anesthesia!! After I was asked to give him another 45 mins, the staff finally let me see him and what I was told was the most horrific news!! That my dog was blind, that he wasn't waking up after surgery, that even though he was giving meds to help him to wake up, it took him almost 20 mins!! I was told that they were not sure if he had brain damage!! 💔 ofc it was 4th of July weekend almost 5pm!! And they were like if anything take him to the ER otherwise come back on Monday 😡 thank God my dog is better, but till this day Noone has reach out to see how hes doing after surgery, I've called multiple times for the biopsy results, 3 times I was told that the vet will call me and hasn't done it!! Everytime I called i told to hold for over 10 mins!! Please be aware where you take your pets!! I would never bring my babies back to this clinic!! Please I need my dog's results!!  I'm wondering if this clinic ever sent his mass for biopsy!! Im in doubt
They really care about each pet that is brought in. And their prices are very reasonable.
Excellent customer service.  Really  takes care of the animals

Unfortunately, this place sucks. Whoever is responsible for scheduling seriously needs to be held accountable.

I had an 11:00 AM appointment and arrived before my scheduled time. Check-in went smoothly, and I understood there would be some waiting since there were several dogs ahead of mine. An additional doctor arrived around the same time I did, so I assumed things would move along.

While waiting, a woman sitting near me started a conversation. After one dog was called back, she asked what time my appointment was. I told her 11:00 AM. She mentioned that she had arrived earlier than the dog that had just been called. She then asked the receptionist what time that dog's appointment was. Shortly afterward, she was called in herself.

A few minutes later, I noticed another dog that had arrived after me was also called back. Meanwhile, I was still waiting. After hours of sitting there, I decided to leave. Keep in mind it was over 100 degrees outside, the waiting area was becoming crowded, and my dog was getting increasingly uncomfortable and anxious.

After I got home, the office called to tell me the doctor was finally ready to see my dog. I asked what time the other dog's appointment had been, and I was told it was also scheduled for 11:00 AM—the same time as mine.

I explained that this was unacceptable and asked for an explanation as to why dogs with the same appointment time, and even dogs that arrived after me, were seen before my dog. The only response I received was, "Sorry about that."

Now my dog is still suffering from an ear infection, and after spending hours waiting, we received no care or assistance. This was an extremely disappointing experience and a complete waste of time. I would not recommend this office to anyone who expects appointments to be honored and patients to be treated fairly.
Staff is very loving and knowledgeable.  They taken great care of my babies.

I 100% recommend this place to anyone who simply cannot afford most veterinary services. They squeezed me in yesterday to save my dog’s life and I cannot thank them enough. She’s doing well now.. I will be back. Thank you so much!!! ❤️
Like all vets they want to talk you into spending more than what you want to but it's ok .I was satisfied..
Great service!!!  Every person on their staff are kind and empathetic.  I highly recommend anyone to bring their pet here.
Terrible service waiting for more than three hours to see the vet. Don't go here dont waste your money on this vet.
